title: TransAlta Reports Strong Third Quarter Results and Reaffirms Guidance
summary: CALGARY, Alberta, Nov. 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- TransAlta Corporation (TransAlta or the Company) (TSX: TA) (NYSE: TAC) today reported its financial results for the third quarter ended...
body_markdown:
CALGARY, Alberta, Nov. 03, 2026[(GLOBE NEWSWIRE)](https://www.globenewswire.com/) --


TransAlta Corporation (TransAlta or the Company) (TSX: TA) (NYSE: TAC) today reported its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.


“TransAlta delivered strong third quarter results driven by high fleet availability, disciplined asset optimization, benefits of our environmental credit portfolio and contributions across our diversified fleet,” said Joel Hunter, President and Chief Executive Officer of TransAlta. "Our Alberta portfolio continued to generate realized prices well above spot prices due to our optimization and hedging programs. With our strong year to date performance, we are confident in achieving our 2026 Outlook range,” added Mr. Hunter.


“I am also very pleased with the continued execution of our strategic priorities. In October, we completed the acquisition of the Colorado gas assets, providing immediate, stable cash flow, and monetized a minority interest in our Oklahoma wind portfolio, strengthening our balance sheet and ability to pursue accretive growth opportunities. We are also advancing the Centralia conversion along with the Keephills data centre project, now known as the Boreal Technology Hub. We recently participated in a community open house with our Boreal partners and continue to progress a solution to deploy our underutilized generation to support both reliability needs and data centre load in the province. Separate to this meaningful progress, we will be temporarily mothballing our Battle River units, while also extending the mothball outage of Sundance 6. The facilities continue to hold significant value, and this action ensures we are optimizing our fleet while preserving the units for future economic benefit as data centre opportunities continue to progress,” added Mr. Hunter.


“As power demand continues to increase, I believe TransAlta is uniquely positioned to leverage its diversified fleet, development capabilities and strategic infrastructure to deliver reliable power and create sustainable long-term value for shareholders,” concluded Mr. Hunter.


**Third Quarter 2026 Highlights**


- Operational availability of 92.6 per cent, compared to 92.7 per cent for the same period in 2025
- Adjusted EBITDA(2) of $264 million, compared to $238 million for the same period in 2025
- Free cash flow (FCF)(2) of $93 million, or $0.29 per share, compared to $105 million, or $0.35 per share, for the same period in 2025
- Adjusted earnings before income taxes(2) of $91 million, compared to $17 million, for the same period in 2025
- Funds from operations(2) of $146 million, or $0.46 per share, compared to $156 million, or $0.53 per share, for the same period in 2025
- Net earnings attributable to common shareholders of $63 million, or $0.20 per share, compared to a net loss of $62 million, or $(0.20) per share, for the same period in 2025

**Significant and Subsequent Events - Third Quarter 2026**


**Mothballing of Battle River Units 4 and 5 and Extension of the Mothballing of Sundance 6**
On Nov. 2, 2026, the Company provided notice to the Alberta Electric System Operator (AESO) that Battle River Units 4 and 5 will be mothballed effective March 1, 2027, for a period of time up to Jan. 1, 2029 and extended the mothballing of Sundance 6 for a period of time up to April 1, 2029. The Company maintains the flexibility to return the mothballed units to service when market fundamentals improve or contracting opportunities are secured. Battle River Units 4 and 5 will remain available and fully operational through to March 1, 2027.


**Sale of minority interest in Oklahoma wind portfolio**
On Oct. 22, 2026, the Company completed the sale of a 49 per cent minority ownership interest in its 500 MW Oklahoma wind portfolio to Ares Infrastructure funds for cash proceeds of US$305 million, before customary closing adjustments. The portfolio comprises the 100 MW White Rock West, 200 MW White Rock East and 200 MW Horizon Hill wind facilities. The Company will continue to provide operational oversight under a long-term asset management agreement.


**Acquisition of Mountain Peak Power and Canyon Peak Power and associated public offering of common shares** On Oct. 22, 2026, the Company closed the acquisition of Mountain Peak Power and Canyon Peak Power, two fully contracted natural gas-fired peaking facilities totaling 318 MW near Denver, Colorado from an indirect subsidiary of Blackstone, Inc. (the Acquisition). The purchase price for the Acquisition was US$1 billion, including the assumption of US$750 million of project debt.


On June 9, 2026, the Company closed a public offering of 18,230,000 common shares at a price of $19.20 per share through a syndicate of underwriters, for total gross proceeds of approximately $350 million, which was used to fund the cash portion of the purchase price for the Acquisition. The proceeds received in advance of the Acquisition were partially used to repay the drawn amounts under the syndicated credit facility.


**Centralia Unit 2 Mandated to Remain Available for additional 90 days** On Sept. 14, 2026, the Company received another order from the U.S. Department of Energy (the Order) requiring that our 700 MW Centralia Unit 2 facility (Facility) remain available for operation for an additional period of 90 days, until Dec. 12, 2026. As previously communicated, the Company has been subject to the Order from the U.S. Department of Energy since Dec. 16, 2025. The Company continues to comply with the Order and continues to work with the federal and state governments in relation thereto. The Facility had no generation during the nine months ended Sept. 30, 2026.


**Declaration of Common Share Dividend** On Oct. 27, 2026, TransAlta's Board of Directors approved a quarterly dividend payment of $0.07 per common share payable on Jan. 1, 2027.

**About TransAlta Corporation:** TransAlta is one of Canada’s largest publicly traded power generators, delivering reliable electricity across Canada, the United States and Western Australia. For more than 100 years, our people have safely operated and evolved essential energy infrastructure that powers customers and communities. Our technology-diverse portfolio and disciplined execution allow us to deliver dependable power across evolving energy systems. We take a practical, responsible approach to meeting today’s energy needs while building for what comes next.
